description: He wears an opaque tan textured ankle-length open robe with wide elbow-length outer sleeves and restrained dark brown-and-gold geometric woven borders along the opening and sleeve ends. A cream linen-like long-sleeved tunic shows at the split neckline, forearms and front and falls near the ankles. A brown-and-gold patterned woven sash wraps the waist with a long fringed end hanging on one side. His ankles are visible above low dark brown leather slip-on shoes. No jewelry, headgear or weapons are visible.
